description:
Drive Quality Innovation as our Next QA Manager (AI & Automation)! 
 Ready to pioneer the future of AI-driven software testing and transform how engineering teams deliver quality at scale? Trimble is looking for an innovative QA Manager to lead our pod quality strategy, leverage cutting-edge AI tools, and hands-on maintain automation frameworks in a modern, collaborative environment!
 About Us: Trimble is empowering stakeholders through planning, design, construction and the entire asset lifecycle . The company’s innovative and connected ecosystem of solutions improves coordination and collaboration between teams, phases and processes. Automating work and transforming workflows, Trimble is enabling teams to deliver with confidence at every turn. For more information, visit: construction.trimble.com.

 What Makes This Role Great : In this role, you will redefine product quality by shifting from traditional testing to an AI-powered, developer-owned quality model. You will act as the master strategist and technical guide for the pod, evaluating advanced AI tools, building automation, and ensuring top-tier software reliability.

 Architect and enforce pod-wide quality strategy while personally authoring test automation using tools like Playwright, Python, C#, or Java.
 Pioneer testing methodologies for embedded AI components, evaluating LLMs, computer vision, and speech recognition while managing AI agents and mitigating bias.
 Evaluate, recommend, and train cross-functional engineering teams on modern AI-driven test tools and automation techniques.
 Orchestrate end-to-end operational workflows, including regressions, release management, and cloud or virtualization test environments.
 Drive data-backed decisions by tracking quality metrics, quantifying coverage gaps, and performing root cause analysis on production incidents to continually improve processes.
 
 Essential Skills & Experience 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, with 10+ years of experience leading software quality strategy and managing global teams.
 Proven ability to write, maintain, and execute test automation scripts personally in Playwright, C#, Python, or Java.
 Strong foundation in core AI concepts (LLM, NLP, ML) with hands-on experience testing AI components, managing AI agents, and using MCP servers.
 Solid background in team-level release management, regression strategy, and virtualization or cloud test environments.
 Outstanding coaching and communication skills to influence quality mindsets and convey technical risk clearly across product and engineering stakeholders.
 Bonus Points For: 
 Experience in global work environments or construction back-office functions and accounting.
 Familiarity with performance, security, chatbot, and embedded AI testing techniques.
 Hands-on proficiency with Jira and C#.
 
 Logistics: 
 Location: Lake Oswego, Portland, Oregon (4 Days In Office) 
 Travel Requirement: 10%

 Why You'll Love Working With Us : At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
 You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that reduce waste.
 Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
 Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
 
 QA Manager, Software Quality Assurance, AI Testing, Test Automation, Playwright, Python, C#, LLM Testing, Model Context Protocol, Quality Engineering, Release Management, Lake Oswego Jobs
